object: a published DSH plugin or bundle pinned to repo@version and commit

grades.A: all five pass, E=ok, no veto
grades.B: E=ok and at least three of A/B/C/D pass
grades.D: any hard gate fails (no dsh.bundle, no license, malicious pattern)

environmentBlocked: E fails only because of an unattended-environment gate; keep B if A-D pass and record environment-blocked

veto.effect: grade D immediately, publish the reason
veto.notClaimed: not a CVE, not a sandbox result, not proof of safety

evidenceDiscipline: every score comes from a reproducible probe, Scorecard run, provenance check, or test-drive record
absent evidence is no-evidence, never a guess
every dimension records an audit link and a snapshot date
report (dsh-report/1) and attestation (dsh-attestation/1) are separate documents

statusMachine.withdrawn: evidence error, misuse, or author withdrawal

transitionRules: draft -> active requires a human organizer signature and a public evidence record
active -> suspended requires an appeal or a review record
active|suspended -> withdrawn requires a reason and a decision-log entry
active -> expired is automatic when expiresAt < today
withdrawn -> active is not allowed; issue a new attestation with a new ID
